name: Nozokimi Yuurei!!
source:
Main character dies in an accident. However, he is not allowed to the heavens under pretext that not all ties with earthly world have been cut yet. He is given two months. He asks himself what he always desired to do most of all - to lose virginity! He is going to use all his powers as a ghost to reach his goal.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在一次事故中死亡。然而，他不被允许进入天堂，借口是尚未切断与尘世的所有联系。他被给予两个月的时间。他问自己，他最想做的事是什么——失去童贞！他要使用自己作为幽灵的所有力量来达到他的目的。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
